releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.6 — voice notes and a smarter story viewer. The composer now records real voice messages: hold the mic to record, slide left to cancel, slide up to lock the recording and keep it going hands-free, then pause and resume or send it — identical in one-to-one and group chats. While you record, the reference gradient bar shows a pulsing red dot, a live timer and a moving waveform, and sent voice notes play back in the bubble with a pause/play control, a filling waveform and their duration. Statuses also behave properly now: a tap only moves forward near the right edge, holding pauses the story, and dragging down dismisses the viewer.
